placement.meaning: Freeze before S9; carry as one machine-readable table plus one short rule. No new run or seat.

exceptions.E1: Read-only frozen inputs and external source text do not count; cite their path only.
exceptions.E2: Machine-readable artifacts and evidence logs have no prose cap; prose cites them by path.
exceptions.E3: An over-cap prose family needs `budget_exception: <reason>`; at most 2 exceptions per run.
exceptions.E4: Content explicitly required by the current user instruction is exempt; mark it `user-mandated` with provenance.

rules.family_aggregation: APPENDIX files count in the same family; splitting bytes across files does not create headroom.
rules.summary_before_appendix: Write the one-page conclusion first; appendices are opt-in and limited.
rules.same_fact_once: A fact appears once; other documents cite its ID or path.
rules.machine_readable_canonical: Node trees, guard matrices, and acceptance commands are JSON/YAML; prose is a <=4KB view.
rules.generated_view_header: A generated markdown view must carry `generated-from:` and point to an existing same-family JSON/YAML source.
rules.qa_measurement: QA records `doc_bytes: <family> <actual>/<cap>` plus a reproducible `wc -c` command.

enforcement_points.EP1: S9 workflow.yaml plan step requires `doc_bytes:` in reports/00-plan.md; this points to this table.
enforcement_points.EP2: QA verdict records per-family actual/cap and a reproducible byte command.
enforcement_points.EP3: wf_close_lint enforces doc_budget headers, family caps, exceptions, and generated-view rules.
enforcement_points.EP4: doc_consistency validates this file, role pointer, template declarations, and the <=2KB DOC-BUDGET.md.
enforcement_points.EP5: generated markdown views are capped at 4KB and must point to an existing canonical JSON/YAML artifact.

adoption.legacyBehavior: Runs without the marker or any doc_budget header are treated as legacy and are not retro-failed; new runs are marked by wf.py new-run.

implementation.planGate: reports/00-plan.md must contain doc_bytes: and point to DOC-BUDGET.json
implementation.closeLint: scripts/wf_close_lint.py checks family caps, exceptions, generated views
implementation.consistency: scripts/doc_consistency.py checks single source, pointers, <=2KB guide and template declarations
